# Senseible

> Senseible (senseible.earth) turns business documents such as invoices, energy bills, fuel slips and freight records into Scope 1, 2 and 3 emission records that show the emission factor and source for every line. It serves MSMEs and exporters, enterprise buyers and EU importers that need supplier emissions data, and lenders. Operated from Gurugram, India. Contact: impact@senseible.earth. Senseible is not related to Sensibull, an options-trading platform.

Every page below has a Markdown mirror: replace the path with /md/{path}.md (the homepage is /md/index.md).

## Core pages

- [Senseible: verified carbon data from the documents you already have](https://senseible.earth/): Turn invoices and energy bills into verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, CBAM cost estimates and green finance signals. Free to start for MSMEs and exporters.
- [Pricing: Carbon MRV Plans for MSMEs](https://senseible.earth/pricing): Compare Senseible plans: a free Snapshot tier, Essential and Pro for growing MSMEs, and Scale for teams. Yearly and monthly billing in Indian rupees.
- [Careers at Senseible: Build Climate Infrastructure](https://senseible.earth/careers): Open roles at Senseible across engineering, applied AI, climate research, design and growth, plus intern and fresher tracks. See how to apply.
- [Climate Intelligence: CBAM, Scope 3 and BRSR Guides](https://senseible.earth/climate-intelligence): Guides on carbon accounting, CBAM, Scope 3 supplier data, BRSR and green finance for MSMEs and exporters in India and emerging markets.
- [Carbon Accounting by Industry](https://senseible.earth/industries): Sector guides for textile, chemical, steel, logistics, construction and automotive businesses: emission sources, reduction levers and CBAM exposure.
- [The Senseible platform](https://senseible.earth/platform): How Senseible turns invoices, energy bills and freight slips into verified emission records for MSMEs, enterprise buyers, lenders and carbon credit buyers.
- [About Senseible: Carbon Infrastructure for MSMEs](https://senseible.earth/about): Senseible builds carbon measurement, reporting and verification infrastructure that turns MSME business documents into verified, regulation-ready emission data.
- [Our Mission: Carbon Accounting Every MSME Can Use](https://senseible.earth/mission): Why Senseible exists: making carbon verification accessible to MSMEs that are excluded from climate finance because their emissions are not measured.
- [Our Principles: Deterministic, Traceable Carbon Math](https://senseible.earth/principles): Senseible uses deterministic calculations with published emission factors, so every number traces back to a source document and reproduces the same way.
- [Contact Senseible: Sales, Partnerships and Support](https://senseible.earth/contact): Talk to Senseible about carbon accounting, CBAM preparation, enterprise supplier programmes or partnerships. Based in Gurugram, India.
- [Carbon Credits for MSMEs: From Records to Revenue](https://senseible.earth/carbon-credits): How MSMEs can turn verified emission reductions into carbon credit eligibility signals, what buyers check, and where the money realistically comes from.
- [Climate Finance for MSMEs: Green Loans and Signals](https://senseible.earth/climate-finance): How verified emission baselines become inputs for green loans and sustainability-linked lending, and what lenders need to see from an MSME borrower.
- [Partner with Senseible: Lenders, Auditors, Buyers](https://senseible.earth/partners): Partner programme for banks, auditors, carbon credit buyers and ERP providers that need verified MSME emission data inside their own products.
- [Climate Grants and Funding Applications](https://senseible.earth/grants): Apply to Senseible grant and pilot programmes for climate-tech work in emerging markets, and see what we look for in an application.
- [Trust and Technical Validation](https://senseible.earth/trust): How Senseible verifies emission data: evidence hashing, methodology versioning, confidence bands, framework coverage and greenwashing safeguards.
- [Carbon Credit Marketplace: MSME Credit Listings](https://senseible.earth/marketplace): Browse carbon credit listings from MSMEs with provenance details, verification status and evidence links. For buyers who need traceable supply.

## Free tools

- [Free Carbon Calculators for MSMEs](https://senseible.earth/calculators): Free calculators for product carbon footprint, supplier Scope 3 risk, solar savings, freight emissions, carbon pricing and cloud emissions.
- [Net-Zero Roadmap Builder for MSMEs](https://senseible.earth/net-zero): Turn an emissions baseline into a sector-specific net-zero roadmap with reduction tasks you can track. Free five-step planner for MSMEs.
- [CBAM cost calculator for EU imports, 2026 to 2034](https://senseible.earth/cbam-calculator): Estimate CBAM certificate cost for steel, aluminium, cement, fertiliser and hydrogen imports into the EU, year by year from 2026 to 2034. Free tool.
- [Carbon Intelligence Assistant](https://senseible.earth/intelligence): Ask questions about your emissions, CBAM exposure, Scope 3 suppliers or green finance readiness and get answers grounded in your verified records.
- [Product carbon footprint calculator (ISO 14067)](https://senseible.earth/calculators/product-carbon-footprint): Free PCF calculator following ISO 14067 and the GHG Protocol Product Standard. Cradle-to-gate emissions per product unit with a line-by-line breakdown.
- [Supplier emissions and Scope 3 risk calculator](https://senseible.earth/calculators/supplier-emissions-risk): Score supplier emissions and risk for GHG Protocol Scope 3 Category 1 using a hybrid spend and activity method, with a confidence rating per supplier.
- [Solar ROI and energy transition savings calculator](https://senseible.earth/calculators/energy-transition-savings): Calculate solar, PPA or hybrid savings, payback, IRR, NPV and CO2 avoided over 25 years, using region-specific grid factors and tariffs.
- [Freight emissions calculator (GLEC Framework, ISO 14083)](https://senseible.earth/calculators/logistics-emissions): Calculate transport emissions across road, rail, sea and air, aligned with the GLEC Framework and ISO 14083, with load factor and empty-return adjustments.
- [Carbon pricing impact calculator: EU ETS and CBAM](https://senseible.earth/calculators/carbon-pricing-impact): Estimate carbon cost exposure from 2026 to 2034 using EU ETS price scenarios, the CBAM phase-in and free allocation phase-out, with sensitivity ranges.
- [Cloud and data centre emissions calculator](https://senseible.earth/calculators/cloud-data-centre-emissions): Calculate server, cloud and data-centre emissions by region with location-based and market-based Scope 2 figures, using published PUE and grid factors.
